synopsis:
The concluding half of *Vector*, carrying the crossover’s final two chapters, published as *Rebellion* Volume 4 and *Legacy* Volume 6.

Darth Vader baits the Rebellion with word of an Imperial secret weapon, and Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa and Han Solo lead a recovery team to the moon where Celeste Morne was abandoned. The plague and the rakghouls take much of the team, and Luke faces Morne and loses. Leia is briefly claimed by the Muur Talisman before Morne, free of its hold at last, takes the relic back to keep its maker’s spirit imprisoned alongside her, and escapes aboard a Rebel ship.

More than a century later Morne commands a rakghoul-infested Star Destroyer, and intercepts Cade Skywalker as he moves to assassinate the Sith Emperor Darth Krayt. Cade’s ability to turn back the plague through dark transfer earns her respect, and the two make common cause against Krayt.

Collecting: Rebellion #15-16, Legacy (2006) #28-31.
title: Star Wars: Vector Volume 2
